brief:
Exit polls suggest Arab parties could secure 18 seats in the Israeli parliament, according to Al Jazeera English. The result would represent a significant showing for the parties, which historically have held fewer legislative positions. Early indications show record-breaking voter turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel, reaching approximately 80 percent.

The high turnout marks a notable shift in participation levels among Israel's Palestinian minority, suggesting heightened political engagement ahead of the final vote count.
dek: Record-breaking voter turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel hits around 80 percent, early indications show.
title: Arab parties gain record support in Israeli elections as Palestinians vote
